summary_1line: Hidden in the grove, Hanuman reflects on the risks of revealing himself to Sita and strategizes how to reassure her without causing fear or alerting the demons.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman crouches unseen among the branches of a tree in the Ashoka grove, watching the sorrowful Sita surrounded by demoness guards below.
Sita, thin and grief-stricken yet radiant, sits beneath a tree like a wilted plant revived by rain while the moonlight softens her face.
Hanuman silently debates within himself high in the branches while fierce demonesses armed with spears and swords keep watch around Sita.
